question: Change the TLSClientConfig field in rest.Config (k8s.io/client-go/rest) from a value type to a pointer type (*TLSClientConfig). rest.Config is the primary struct used to configure Kubernetes API client connections. Any code that directly assigns or constructs rest.TLSClientConfig{} literals on a rest.Config will break because the field now expects a pointer, requiring &rest.TLSClientConfig{} instead.
